summary: Summit Hotel Properties, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing entry into an equity distribution agreement for an at-the-market (ATM) offering of up to $200 million of common stock through multiple sales agents and forward sellers. The filing is a routine capital-raising arrangement under Rule 415, not a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No deal terms, premium, or special event are involved. The ATM program provides ongoing flexibility for issuing shares at market prices, with no immediate transaction or strategic change; thus it does not qualify as a special situation.
